title: pomaria lactea
intro: Pomaria lactea, commonly known as the Milk-leaf or Sensitive Joint-vine, is a plant species native to tropical and subtropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its antiseptic and antifungal properties, which make it useful in treating wounds and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Pomaria lactea include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
